DEPARTMENT OF THE ARMY
BALTIMORE DISTRICT, CORPS OF ENGINEERS P.O. BOX 1715 BALTIMORE, MARYLAND 21203
NABPL-E
3 August 1973
Mr. James Corbin, Director
Community Development Disaster
Recovery Office
Department of Housing and Urban
Development
Lackawanna County Building
Spruce and Adams Avenue
Scranton, Pennsylvania 18503
Dear Mr. Corbin:
Your agency's letter of 28 June 1973 to the Office of the Chief of Engineers requesting review and comments on the Draft Environmental Impact Statement for the Penn Susquehanna Urban Renewal Project, Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, has been referred to the Baltimore District for reply since the project lies within this District's boundaries. This office has reviewed the EIS and the following comments are offered to assist you in preparation of the final EIS.
In the last paragraph on page 49, it is stated that new flood plain and floodway areas are to be established by the U.S. Corps of Army Engineers. The Corps has prepared maps of the Harrisburg area showing the 100-year frequency flood line and the June 1972 (Agnes) flood line. However, this office has no request or directive to set floodway areas for the Harrisburg area.
The list of flood control measures on page 81 which was taken from the Corps EIS are alternatives which were considered as having potential for reducing flood damage in the area.
As requested, the Council on Environmental Quality has been forwarded copies of this letter.
Sincerely yours,
WILLIAM E. TRIESCHMAN, Jr.
Chief, Planning Division
